name: Bunchasai
source:
Main character somehow becomes a school festival executive committee member. He gets a task to find participants in cute girls competition as school mascots.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公不知怎的成为了学园祭执行委员会成员，并接到一项任务：寻找可爱少女比赛的参赛者，让她们担任学校吉祥物。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
